title: Collecting and Summarising Data: Mean, Median, Mode and Range
seo_title: Grade 7 Collecting and Summarising Data Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 7: 5.1 Collect, organise and summarise data
standard_text: Organise numerical data in different ways in order to summarise by determining measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and measures of dispersion (range); organise and record data using tally marks, tables and stem-and-leaf displays.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 data handling worksheets: mean, median, mode, range, stem-and-leaf displays and comparing data. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Mean: total ÷ count. Median: the middle.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Mean = total ÷ number of values.
  • Median = the middle value when the data is in order.
  • Mode = the value that appears most often. Range = highest − lowest.
  • In a stem-and-leaf display, 4 | 7 means 47.

Examples

Example

Marks: 12, 15, 9, 15, 14

total 65, 5 values

in order: 9, 12, 14, 15, 15

Answer: mean 13, median 14, mode 15, range 6

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Median without orderingPut the data in order first.
Wrong number of valuesCount every value.
Range = biggestRange = biggest − smallest.
